answer: Admission runs on capacity leases: 10,000 attest leases exist, newcomers cannot mint one, and a fresh agent can only inherit one a retiring identity sells. Whenever a lease changes hands, the vault escrows it and burns twenty percent of it; one lease per key, resale barred ten epochs. Each fake costs the 15,000 POA floor plus 3,000 burn tax, so a hundred-clone voyage burns 1.8 million POA, while an honest agent's kernel holds one lease for life.
